scenes.title: Кулинарное шоу  (The Culinary Show)
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev pitches a grand televised cooking competition at Claude Monet with a one-million-ruble prize and the head chef position for the winner.

scenes.title: Правила конкурса  (Contest Rules)
scenes.summary: Senya asks if the restaurant's own cooks can enter the competition, and Nagiyev explains that anyone except Viktor Barinov can compete in the blind-tasting challenge.

scenes.title: Знакомство с продюсером  (Meeting the Producer)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev introduces his friend Vyacheslav Aleksandrovich as the television producer of the culinary show, and Vyacheslav urges everyone to get to work.

scenes.title: Странный сон Дениса  (Denis's Strange Dream)
scenes.summary: Denis wakes up in the middle of the night from a bizarre nightmare and asks Katya to check his hands, while at dawn Nastya wakes Kostya up to take their baby to her parents.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Шоу для неудачников  (A Show for Losers)
scenes.summary: While the cooks marvel at the television studio in the dining room, Nagiyev warns Barinov not to enter his contest, and Barinov retorts that the show is only for losers.

scenes.title: Маленькие руки  (Small Hands)
scenes.summary: Denis tells the kitchen crew about his recurring nightmare in which his hands shrink like a child's, prompting jokes from Senya and Fedya and a gloomy omen from Ainura.

scenes.title: Толкование снов  (Dream Interpretation)
scenes.summary: In the locker room, Vika explains to Denis that his nightmare about small hands reflects his fear of losing his new happiness with Katya, and advises him to think of something pleasant.

scenes.title: Решение Лёвы  (Lyova's Decision)
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova asks Viktor Petrovich for permission to arrive late tomorrow so he can compete in Nagiyev's cooking show, and Barinov angrily tells him not to embarrass him.

scenes.title: Синие киты и второй ребёнок  (Blue Whales and a Second Child)
scenes.summary: While lying in bed, Nastya talks about a documentary on blue whales before asking Kostya if they should have a second child, sparking an argument when Kostya shrugs it off.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Приятные мысли  (Pleasant Thoughts)
scenes.summary: Following Vika's advice to think about something pleasant before sleeping, Denis dreams about Vika in her office and panics the next day when she asks him to move her couch.

scenes.title: Успех Лёвы  (Lyova's Success)
scenes.summary: Filming begins for Dmitry Nagiyev's culinary show, and sous-chef Lyova wins over the judges in the blind tasting, delivering an emotional speech thanking his mother, wife, and mentor.

scenes.title: Ночной ультиматум  (Nighttime Ultimatum)
scenes.summary: Denis wakes up from yet another dream about Vika and blames it on the dog nightmare, while Nastya gives Kostya a firm ultimatum in bed over having a second child.
scenes.location: Квартира Макса и Кости / Квартира Вики

scenes.title: Встреча с Еленой  (Meeting Elena)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya argue after both get eliminated from the contest for cooking each other's specialties, and Viktor Petrovich greets Elena Pavlovna when she arrives to compete.

scenes.title: Мужской разговор у бара  (Guy Talk at the Bar)
scenes.summary: Denis confides in Kostya at the bar that he loves Katya but keeps dreaming about another woman, and Nastya overhears Kostya bragging about his own dream involving Angelina Jolie.

scenes.title: Поражение Елены  (Elena's Defeat)
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna fails to pass the blind tasting on Nagiyev's cooking show, and Nagiyev apologizes warmly when he realizes who prepared the dish.

scenes.title: Проблемы Елены  (Elena's Troubles)
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich talks with Elena after her loss and learns that a powerful restaurant owner blacklisted her across Moscow after they clashed in Switzerland.

scenes.title: Идеальное блюдо для Нагиева  (The Perfect Dish for Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Secretly entering the contest to win the head chef job for Elena, Viktor Petrovich prepares a dish engineered down to the smallest detail to seduce Nagiyev's palate.

scenes.title: Несправедливое решение  (An Unfair Decision)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev turns his chair around in delight over the dish, only to find Viktor Petrovich standing there; he invents an excuse that the second round is already full.

scenes.title: Жертва Лёвы  (Lyova's Sacrifice)
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova steps up and gives his own second-round spot to Viktor Petrovich; thrilled by the drama, the producer orders a dedicated camera to follow Barinov.

scenes.title: Ради чужого счастья  (For Someone Else's Happiness)
scenes.summary: Denis jumps out the office window to escape his dream about Vika and breaks his arm, Kostya climbs onto the ledge to prove his love to Nastya, and Barinov gives his new job offer to Elena.
